text: Building a mobile app is an exciting process, but it requires careful planning. One of the first decisions is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a specific system, like iOS or Android, which often means better performance and smoother animations. Cross-platform apps, on the other hand, use one codebase for both, saving time and money, though they may sometimes feel slightly less responsive. Another critical factor is responsive design. Your app must look and work well on various screen sizes, from small phones to tablets. Finally, you must consider app stores. Submitting your app to the Apple App Store or Google Play involves following strict guidelines and a review process. Regular updates and fixes are also vital to keep performance high and users happy.
